title: Norwegian Quake League
wikitext:
The first national Quake League in Norway. Started in January 1997 and only lasted for two season, until the fall of 1997. Was replaced by [[Norwegian Clan League]] in 1998.

=== Season 1 ===

* '''Clans:''' [[Carnage Clan]], [[Spawn Clan]], [[The Vicious Vikings]], [[Grendel Warriors]], [[Zombie Wipeout]], [[The Bush Wackers]], [[Sitting Ducks]], [[Helheim Kommando]], [[Klan Nivlheim]] and Avengers of Chimaera.

* '''Results:''' Won by Carnage Clan, with Spawn Clan in 2nd place and The Vicious Vikings 3rd. Further standings unknown.

=== Season 2 ===

The second season was started in September 1997. Results are unknown. The season might not have been finished, as several clans were dissolved while the season was ongoing, among them [[Carnage Clan]] and [[Spawn Clan]].
